from scipy.optimize import least_squares

__all__ = ['align_coupon_features', 'hereditary_hold', 'allocate_box_simplex']


def align_coupon_features(raw: np.ndarray, reference: np.ndarray, groups: np.ndarray, strata: np.ndarray) -> tuple[np.ndarray, np.ndarray]:
    """Return aligned/imputed features and the original row missingness mask.

    Matrices share a row axis. Known labels identify groups and strata. Each
    group has a shared offset and positive gain, measured by a comparable
    reference panel. Use medians of reference-column means and population
    standard deviations (at least two finite entries per column). Fill each
    missing feature by the mean of observed cell means for that feature, one
    vote per observed group-stratum cell. There is no gain floor or shrinkage;
    a wholly missing feature is filled at the reference origin. An unlabeled
    target panel may be included when transductive alignment is appropriate.
    """
    x, ref = np.asarray(raw, float), np.asarray(reference, float)
    groups, strata = np.asarray(groups), np.asarray(strata)
    if x.ndim != 2 or not all(x.shape) or ref.ndim != 2 or len(ref) != len(x) or groups.shape != (len(x),) or strata.shape != groups.shape:
        raise ValueError('feature, reference and label arrays must share a nonempty row axis')
    present = np.isfinite(x)
    out = np.full(x.shape, np.nan)
    cell_means = []
    for group in np.unique(groups):
        rows = groups == group
        block = ref[rows]
        block = block[:, np.isfinite(block).sum(axis=0) >= 2]
        if not block.shape[1]:
            raise ValueError('each group needs a usable reference column')
        block = np.where(np.isfinite(block), block, np.nan)
        center = np.median(np.nanmean(block, axis=0))
        scale = np.median(np.nanstd(block, axis=0, ddof=0))
        if not np.isfinite(center) or not np.isfinite(scale) or scale <= 0:
            raise ValueError('reference center must be finite and scale positive')
        out[rows] = (np.where(present[rows], x[rows], np.nan) - center) / scale
        for stratum in np.unique(strata[rows]):
            cell = out[rows & (strata == stratum)]
            count = np.isfinite(cell).sum(axis=0)
            cell_means.append(np.divide(np.nansum(cell, axis=0), count, out=np.full(x.shape[1], np.nan), where=count > 0))
    cells = np.asarray(cell_means)
    count = np.isfinite(cells).sum(axis=0)
    fill = np.divide(np.nansum(cells, axis=0), count, out=np.zeros(x.shape[1]), where=count > 0)
    return np.where(present, out, fill), ~present.all(axis=1)


def hereditary_hold(history: np.ndarray, durations: np.ndarray, initial_memory: np.ndarray, hold: np.ndarray, times: np.ndarray, features: np.ndarray, baseline: np.ndarray, stress_scale: float, tau_bounds: tuple[float, float], *, curves: np.ndarray | None = None, observed_rate: np.ndarray | None = None, incomplete: np.ndarray | None = None, parameters: tuple[np.ndarray, np.ndarray] | None = None) -> tuple[np.ndarray, np.ndarray, np.ndarray, np.ndarray]:
    """Fit or evaluate a two-mode linear hereditary hold with constant drift.

    Pass lab-calibrated stresses and the physical starting memory (fast and
    slow columns, in the same stress units). History is piecewise constant,
    oldest first, with shared durations. Use a positive stress reference and
    common units for durations, hold times and tau bounds. Features must be
    dimensionless and already aligned/imputed. Nonfinite observations are
    omitted. Fit uses a soft-L1 pilot and two Cauchy passes with separate
    strain/rate MAD scales, cutoff 2.3849 times scale, and no coefficient ridge.
    Returns ordered taus, physical coefficients (two compliances, drift
    intercept, feature slopes), strain, and right initial rate. To predict
    without refitting, pass the first two outputs as parameters. When a row is
    marked incomplete and has a finite observed rate, adjust only its drift.
    """
    h, dt, z0, s, t, x, base = map(lambda a: np.asarray(a, float), (history, durations, initial_memory, hold, times, features, baseline))
    if h.ndim != 2 or not len(h) or dt.shape != (h.shape[1],) or z0.shape != (len(h), 2) or s.shape != (len(h),) or base.shape != s.shape or t.ndim != 1 or x.ndim != 2 or len(x) != len(h):
        raise ValueError('incompatible hereditary input shapes')
    low, T = map(float, tau_bounds)
    Y = float(stress_scale)
    if not np.isfinite([low, T, Y]).all() or not 0 < low < T or Y <= 0 or not all(np.isfinite(a).all() for a in (h, dt, z0, s, t, x, base)) or np.any(dt < 0) or np.any(t < 0):
        raise ValueError('need finite inputs, nonnegative times and positive physical scales')
    h, z0, s, dt, t = h / Y, z0 / Y, s / Y, dt / T, t / T
    n, k = len(h), len(t)
    f = np.column_stack((np.ones(n), x))
    drift = f[:, None, :] * np.r_[t, 1.0][None, :, None]
    conversion = np.r_[Y, Y, np.full(f.shape[1], T)]
    rate = np.full(n, np.nan) if observed_rate is None else np.asarray(observed_rate, float)
    mask = np.zeros(n, bool) if incomplete is None else np.asarray(incomplete, bool)
    if rate.shape != (n,) or mask.shape != (n,):
        raise ValueError('rate and missingness mask must have one entry per row')

    def design(logq: np.ndarray) -> tuple[np.ndarray, np.ndarray]:
        q = np.exp(logq)
        z, dz = z0.copy(), np.zeros_like(z0)
        for j, d in enumerate(dt):
            v = d / q
            decay = np.exp(-v)
            delta = z - h[:, j, None]
            dz = decay * (dz + delta * v)
            z = decay * z - np.expm1(-v) * h[:, j, None]
        gap = s[:, None] - z
        v = t[:, None] / q
        kernel = np.vstack((-np.expm1(-v), 1.0 / q))
        derivative = np.vstack((-v * np.exp(-v), -1.0 / q))
        modes = gap[:, None, :] * kernel
        dlog = gap[:, None, :] * derivative - dz[:, None, :] * kernel
        return np.concatenate((modes, drift), axis=2), dlog

    if parameters is None:
        obs = np.full((n, k + 1), np.nan)
        if curves is not None:
            c = np.asarray(curves, float)
            if c.shape != (n, k):
                raise ValueError('curves must match rows and hold times')
            obs[:, :k] = c - base[:, None]
        obs[:, k] = rate * T
        good = np.isfinite(obs)
        y = obs[good]
        if y.size < conversion.size + 2 or not np.any(y):
            raise ValueError('insufficient observations for two-mode inversion')
        response = max(np.median(np.abs(y)), 1e-6 * np.max(np.abs(y)))
        y = y / response
        is_rate = np.broadcast_to(np.arange(k + 1) == k, obs.shape)[good]
        L = np.log(low / T)

        def ordered(ab: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
            fast = L * (1 - ab[0])
            return np.array([fast, fast * (1 - ab[1])])

        def model(p: np.ndarray) -> tuple[np.ndarray, np.ndarray, np.ndarray]:
            mat, da = design(ordered(p[:2]))
            mat = mat[good]
            return mat @ p[2:] - y, da[good] * p[2:4], mat

        def scales(r: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
            sigma = np.empty_like(r)
            for select in (is_rate, ~is_rate):
                if select.any():
                    a = r[select]
                    sigma[select] = max(1.4826 * np.median(np.abs(a - np.median(a))), 1e-8)
            return sigma

        def optimize(p: np.ndarray, sigma: np.ndarray, loss: str):
            def jac(v: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
                _, dlog, mat = model(v)
                chain = np.array([[-L, 0.0], [-L * (1 - v[1]), -ordered(v[:2])[0]]])
                return np.column_stack((dlog @ chain, mat)) / sigma[:, None]
            return least_squares(lambda v: model(v)[0] / sigma, p, jac=jac,
                                 bounds=(np.r_[0.0, 0.0, np.full(conversion.size, -np.inf)],
                                         np.r_[1.0, 1.0, np.full(conversion.size, np.inf)]),
                                 loss=loss, x_scale='jac', max_nfev=300, ftol=1e-9)

        starts = []
        for ab in ((0.22, 0.64), (0.40, 0.78), (0.12, 0.46)):
            mat = design(ordered(np.asarray(ab)))[0][good]
            starts.append(np.r_[ab, np.linalg.lstsq(mat, y, rcond=None)[0]])
        pilot = scales(model(starts[0])[0])
        fits = [optimize(p, pilot, 'soft_l1') for p in starts]
        fits = [fit for fit in fits if fit.success]
        if not fits:
            raise ValueError('hereditary pilot fit did not converge')
        p = min(fits, key=lambda fit: fit.cost).x
        for _ in range(2):
            sigma = 2.3849 * scales(model(p)[0])
            fit = optimize(p, sigma, 'cauchy')
            if not fit.success:
                raise ValueError('robust hereditary fit did not converge')
            p = fit.x
        logq = ordered(p[:2])
        r, dlog, mat = model(p)
        J = np.column_stack((dlog, mat)) / (sigma * np.hypot(1.0, r / sigma))[:, None]
        sv = np.linalg.svd(J, compute_uv=False)
        if -np.expm1(logq[0] - logq[1]) <= 0.001 or sv[-1] <= 1e-8 * sv[0]:
            raise ValueError('two relaxation modes are not separately identifiable')
        tau, beta = T * np.exp(logq), p[2:] * response
        coef = beta / conversion
    else:
        tau, coef = (np.asarray(a, float) for a in parameters)
        if tau.shape != (2,) or coef.shape != conversion.shape or not np.isfinite(coef).all() or not low <= tau[0] < tau[1] <= T:
            raise ValueError('need ordered relaxation times and matching finite coefficients')
        logq, beta = np.log(tau / T), coef * conversion
    pred = design(logq)[0] @ beta
    use = mask & np.isfinite(rate)
    pred[use, :k] += (rate[use] * T - pred[use, k])[:, None] * t
    pred[use, k] = rate[use] * T
    return tau, coef, base[:, None] + pred[:, :k], pred[:, k] / T


def allocate_box_simplex(modes: np.ndarray, observations: np.ndarray, cap: float, budget: float, *, nuisance: np.ndarray | None = None, nuisance_ridge: float = 1e-6, source_ridge: float = 1e-8) -> tuple[np.ndarray, dict[str, float | np.ndarray]]:
    """Solve a ridge-stabilized allocation with a uniform cap and fixed sum.

    Pass the physical mode matrix after any sample-dependent modulation. If a
    nuisance basis Z is supplied, apply R = I - Z (Z.T Z + ridge I)^-1 Z.T to
    both modes and observations, and minimize the squared residual in those
    coordinates. With nonzero nuisance ridge this is not the joint profiled
    ridge objective. Default ridges 1e-6 and 1e-8 refer to the supplied basis
    and mode units, respectively; transform them when changing those units.
    The certificate uses stationarity grad - nu_sum - lam_lower + lam_upper
    = 0 and a box-minimized tangent lower bound on the primal objective.
    """
    S, y = np.asarray(modes, float), np.asarray(observations, float)
    if S.ndim != 2 or not all(S.shape) or y.shape != (S.shape[0],) or not np.isfinite(S).all() or not np.isfinite(y).all():
        raise ValueError('need a finite mode matrix and matching observations')
    m = S.shape[1]
    if not np.isfinite([cap, budget, source_ridge, nuisance_ridge]).all() or cap <= 0 or not 0 <= budget <= m * cap or source_ridge <= 0 or nuisance_ridge < 0:
        raise ValueError('require a feasible budget, positive cap and source ridge, and nonnegative nuisance ridge')
    if nuisance is not None:
        Z = np.asarray(nuisance, float)
        if Z.ndim != 2 or Z.shape[0] != len(y) or not np.isfinite(Z).all():
            raise ValueError('nuisance must share the observation axis')
        if Z.shape[1]:
            joint = np.column_stack((S, y))
            joint -= Z @ np.linalg.solve(Z.T @ Z + nuisance_ridge * np.eye(Z.shape[1]), Z.T @ joint)
            S, y = joint[:, :-1], joint[:, -1]

    A = S * cap
    ridge = source_ridge * cap**2
    Q, c = A.T @ A + ridge * np.eye(m), A.T @ y
    scale = max(np.max(np.abs(Q)), np.max(np.abs(c)))
    Q, c = Q / scale, c / scale
    b = budget / cap
    x, active = np.full(m, b / m), np.zeros(m, int)
    ptol, dtol = 64 * np.finfo(float).eps, 1e-11
    if budget == 0:
        nu = float(np.min(-c))
    elif budget == m * cap:
        x[:] = 1.0
        nu = float(np.max(Q @ x - c))
    else:
        for _ in range(20 * m * m):
            free = active == 0
            g = Q @ x - c
            if not free.any():
                lo = np.argmin(np.where(active < 0, g, np.inf))
                hi = np.argmax(np.where(active > 0, g, -np.inf))
                nu = (g[lo] + g[hi]) / 2
                if g[lo] >= g[hi] - dtol:
                    break
                active[[lo, hi]] = 0
                continue
            ids = np.flatnonzero(free)
            v, h = np.linalg.solve(Q[np.ix_(ids, ids)], np.column_stack((g[ids], np.ones(len(ids))))).T
            nu = v.sum() / h.sum()
            step = nu * h - v
            pos, neg = step > ptol, step < -ptol
            limits = np.full(len(ids), np.inf)
            limits[pos] = (1.0 - x[ids[pos]]) / step[pos]
            limits[neg] = -x[ids[neg]] / step[neg]
            j = np.argmin(limits)
            if limits[j] < 1.0:
                x[ids] += max(0.0, limits[j]) * step
                active[ids[j]] = 1 if pos[j] else -1
                x[ids[j]] = float(pos[j])
                continue
            if np.max(np.abs(step)) > ptol:
                x[ids] += step
            violation = active * (Q @ x - c - nu)
            j = np.argmax(violation)
            if violation[j] <= dtol:
                break
            active[j] = 0
        else:
            raise RuntimeError('allocation active set did not converge')
    x = np.clip(x, 0.0, 1.0)
    if abs(x.sum() - b) > 1e-10 * max(1.0, b):
        raise RuntimeError('allocation lost budget feasibility')
    w = cap * x
    residual = S @ w - y
    g = S.T @ residual + source_ridge * w
    nu = float(nu * scale / cap)
    obj = 0.5 * (residual @ residual + source_ridge * (w @ w))
    reduced = g - nu
    dual = obj - g @ w + nu * budget + cap * np.minimum(reduced, 0.0).sum()
    cert = dict(weights=w, nu_sum=nu,
                lam_lower=np.where(x <= ptol, np.maximum(reduced, 0.0), 0.0),
                lam_upper=np.where(x >= 1.0 - ptol, np.maximum(-reduced, 0.0), 0.0),
                primal_objective=float(obj), dual_lower_bound=float(dual))
    return w, cert

def run_self_test():
    check = np.testing.assert_allclose
    groups = np.array([2, 2, 2, 7, 7, 7])
    strata = np.array([0, 0, 1, 0, 0, 1])
    raw = np.array([[0., 0.], [2., np.nan], [4., 2.], [8., 4.], [np.nan, 6.], [10., np.nan]])
    ref = np.array([-1., 0., 1., -1., 0., 1.])[:, None]
    aligned, missing = align_coupon_features(raw, ref, groups, strata)
    expected = np.array([[0., 0.], [2., 7/3], [4., 2.], [8., 4.], [23/4, 6.], [10., 7/3]]) / np.sqrt(2/3)
    check(aligned, expected, atol=1e-13)
    np.testing.assert_array_equal(missing, [False, True, False, False, True, True])
    p = np.array([5, 2, 0, 3, 1, 4])
    a = np.where(groups == 2, 3., 0.2)[:, None]
    b = np.where(groups == 2, -7., 40.)[:, None]
    remapped, mm = align_coupon_features((a * raw + b)[p], (a * ref + b)[p], (11 - groups)[p], (3 - strata)[p])
    check(remapped, aligned[p], atol=1e-12)
    np.testing.assert_array_equal(mm, missing[p])

    rng = np.random.default_rng(190)
    n = 24
    dt = np.array([0.22, 0.31, 0.17])
    t = np.r_[0., np.geomspace(0.04, 8., 23)]
    tau0 = np.array([0.46, 2.85])
    coef0 = np.array([0.12, 0.07, 0.008, -0.003])
    bounds = (0.12, 9.)
    hist, z0, hold = (rng.uniform(-0.8, 0.8, shape) for shape in ((n, 3), (n, 2), n))
    features = rng.normal(size=(n, 1))
    baseline = rng.normal(scale=0.01, size=n)
    drift = coef0[2] + coef0[3] * features[:, 0]
    clean = baseline[:, None] + drift[:, None] * t
    rate = drift.copy()
    # Independent terminal state: integrate each piecewise-constant interval.
    edges = np.r_[0., np.cumsum(dt)]
    for j, q in enumerate(tau0):
        coeff = np.diff(np.exp(-(edges[-1] - edges) / q))
        terminal = z0[:, j] * np.exp(-edges[-1] / q) + hist @ coeff
        amp = coef0[j] * (hold - terminal)
        clean += amp[:, None] * (1.0 - np.exp(-t / q))
        rate += amp / q
    obs = clean.copy()
    obs[::4, 5] = np.nan
    fit_rate = rate.copy()
    fit_rate[::5] = np.nan

    def fit(s, u, order):
        fitted = hereditary_hold(hist[order] * s, dt * u, z0[order] * s, hold[order] * s, t * u,
                                 features[order], baseline[order], s, tuple(np.array(bounds) * u),
                                 curves=obs[order], observed_rate=fit_rate[order] / u)
        tau, coef, pred, first = fitted
        assert all(np.isfinite(x).all() for x in fitted)
        check(tau / u, tau0, rtol=2e-6)
        check(coef * [s, s, u, u], coef0, rtol=2e-6)
        check(pred, clean[order], atol=2e-8)
        check(first * u, rate[order], atol=2e-8)
        return fitted

    tau, coef, pred, first = fit(1., 1., np.arange(n))
    fit(0.01, 0.5, rng.permutation(n))
    # Double the inverse time scale; rates double, taus halve, strain is unchanged.
    need = np.arange(n) < 3
    measured = rate + 0.013
    measured[1] = np.nan
    _, _, updated, first_updated = hereditary_hold(hist, dt, z0, hold, t, features, baseline, 1., bounds,
                                                      parameters=(tau, coef), observed_rate=measured, incomplete=need)
    check(updated[0] - pred[0], (measured[0] - first[0]) * t, atol=2e-12)
    check(first_updated[0], measured[0], atol=2e-12)
    check(updated[1], pred[1], atol=2e-12)
    check(updated[3:], pred[3:], atol=2e-12)
    check(updated[:, 0], baseline, atol=2e-12)

    # Construct a projected quadratic with one lower, one free and one upper weight.
    S = np.vstack((np.diag([1., 2., 3.]), np.zeros(3)))
    Z = np.array([[0.], [1.], [0.], [1.]])
    w0 = np.array([0., 0.4, 0.7])
    grad0 = np.array([0.7, 0.2, -0.4])
    rn, rw, cap, budget = 0.3, 0.2, 0.7, 1.1
    R = np.eye(4) - Z @ Z.T / (float((Z.T @ Z)[0, 0]) + rn)
    residual = np.linalg.lstsq(S.T @ R @ R, grad0 - rw * w0, rcond=None)[0]
    y = S @ w0 - residual
    w, cert = allocate_box_simplex(S, y, cap, budget, nuisance=Z, nuisance_ridge=rn, source_ridge=rw)
    check(w, w0, atol=2e-11)
    assert np.isfinite(w).all() and all(np.isfinite(v).all() for v in cert.values())
    check(w.sum(), budget, atol=1e-12)
    g = S.T @ R @ R @ (S @ w - y) + rw * w
    lo, hi = cert['lam_lower'], cert['lam_upper']
    assert np.all(lo >= 0) and np.all(hi >= 0)
    check(g - cert['nu_sum'] - lo + hi, 0., atol=2e-11)
    check(lo * w, 0., atol=2e-11)
    check(hi * (cap - w), 0., atol=2e-11)
    r = R @ (S @ w - y)
    check(cert['primal_objective'], (r @ r + rw * (w @ w)) / 2, atol=2e-12)
    assert abs(cert['primal_objective'] - cert['dual_lower_bound']) < 2e-11
    # Relabel the mode columns and change response, weight and nuisance units.
    perm = np.array([2, 0, 1])
    a, b, c = 0.01, 2.0, 3.0
    v, second = allocate_box_simplex(S[:, perm] * a / b, y * a, cap * b, budget * b,
                                     nuisance=Z * c, nuisance_ridge=rn * c**2, source_ridge=rw * (a / b)**2)
    check(v / b, w[perm], atol=2e-11)
    check(second['dual_lower_bound'] / a**2, cert['dual_lower_bound'], atol=2e-11)
    for total in (0.0, 3 * cap):
        edge, proof = allocate_box_simplex(S, y, cap, total, source_ridge=rw)
        check(edge, np.full(3, total / 3), atol=1e-12)
        check(proof['primal_objective'], proof['dual_lower_bound'], atol=2e-11)


run_self_test()
